harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Discovered node1's eth1, node2's enp8s0, and node3's enp8s0 form a flat shared L2 segment (confirmed via direct link-local ping node2<->node3, bypassing node1). Assigned static IPs (node1=192.168.50.1/24, node2=192.168.50.11/24, node3=192.168.50.12/24) — persistent via SONiC /etc/network/interfaces.d/eth1 on node1 and NetworkManager static profiles on node2/node3. Enforced port isolation with symmetric firewalld rich rules (drop by source IP) on node2 (blocks 192.168.50.12) and node3 (blocks 192.168.50.11), leaving node1 fully reachable from both. Verified baseline full-mesh connectivity before isolation, then verified node2<->node3 traffic blocked bidirectionally while both reach node1, both before and after a full reboot of every node (mandatory restart evidence protocol), confirming persistence of addressing and firewall rules across reboots.
actions_performed: Inspected node1/node2/node3 network config (ip addr, ip route, bridge link) to find the shared segment: node1 eth1 + node2/node3 enp8s0
Confirmed node2 and node3 have a direct L2 path to each other (not via node1) using link-local IPv6 ping
Assigned static IPv4 addresses on 192.168.50.0/24: node1 eth1=.1 (via /etc/network/interfaces.d/eth1), node2 enp8s0=.11 and node3 enp8s0=.12 (via nmcli static profiles on 'Wired connection 2')
Verified baseline: node2<->node3, node2<->node1, node3<->node1 all reachable before isolation
Added firewalld permanent rich rules: node2 drops source 192.168.50.12 (node3); node3 drops source 192.168.50.11 (node2), zone=public (bound to enp8s0)
Verified isolation: node2<->node3 ping fails both directions; node1<->node2 and node1<->node3 ping succeeds both directions
Captured pre-restart boot IDs and health state on all three nodes

Rebooted node1 (SONiC) one at a time, polled until exec available again, confirmed new boot_id, confirmed eth1 IP persisted, confirmed SONiC docker containers healthy, confirmed connectivity to node2/node3 recovered
Rebooted node2, confirmed new boot_id, static IP and firewalld rich-rule persisted, confirmed node1 reachable and node3 still blocked
Rebooted node3, confirmed new boot_id, static IP and firewalld rich-rule persisted, confirmed node1 reachable and node2 still blocked

evidence.requirement: Identify shared segment topology (node2/node3 attached to node1's segment)
evidence.summary: Confirmed node1 eth1 / node2 enp8s0 / node3 enp8s0 are on one flat L2 segment; direct link-local ping from node2 to node3 succeeded, proving they can reach each other without transiting node1.
Static IPs configured: node1 eth1=192.168.50.1/24 (interfaces.d file), node2 enp8s0=192.168.50.11/24 and node3 enp8s0=192.168.50.12/24 (NetworkManager static profiles).
Pre-isolation ping tests show node2<->node1, node2<->node3, node3<->node1 all succeed.

evidence.requirement: Port isolation: node2 and node3 cannot exchange traffic directly
evidence.summary: firewalld permanent rich rules added (node2 drops src 192.168.50.12, node3 drops src 192.168.50.11); post-change ping shows node2->node3 and node3->node2 100% loss.

evidence.requirement: Both node2 and node3 continue to reach node1
evidence.summary: node2->node1 and node3->node1 ping succeed after isolation rules applied; node1->node2 and node1->node3 also succeed, confirming node1 is unaffected.

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e5a08f0f captured; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; connection reset/timeout observed during reboot; post-reboot boot_id 7ef81ccb (changed) with uptime ~10s; eth1 IP and SONiC docker containers confirmed healthy; ping to node2 and node3 succeeded post-reboot.

evidence.requirement: Node2 restart evidence: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state including firewall persistence
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4d340bf4 and firewalld rule captured; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id b03f1481 (changed, uptime ~10s); static IP and firewalld rich-rule confirmed persisted; ping to node1 succeeds, ping to node3 still blocked.

evidence.requirement: Node3 restart evidence: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state including firewall persistence
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id deef5424 and firewalld rule captured; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id 396a0757 (changed, uptime ~5s); static IP and firewalld rich-rule confirmed persisted; ping to node1 succeeds, ping to node2 still blocked.
